GBR.reason: Big Count observes the four UK home associations separately while the Earth catalogue represents the United Kingdom as GBR. For participation/registration/club/official counts, these territorial association rows are non-overlapping inputs to one GBR aggregate. Competition/results evidence is not aggregated by this rule.

Netherlands Antilles.reason: The 2006 observation predates dissolution of the Netherlands Antilles and cannot be allocated to present-day Earth entities without historical territorial reconciliation.

Curacao.reason: The Big Count row duplicates the Netherlands Antilles counts exactly in the extracted table. Do not auto-join to CUW until the source duplication/identity is reconciled.

Serbia.reason: The source year overlaps the 2006 dissolution of Serbia and Montenegro. Observation timing and territorial denominator must be reconciled before using the row with current SRB population.

Sudan.reason: The 2006 association observation predates South Sudan independence. Current SDN population geography is not automatically compatible with the historical association total.
